intro: What each role can do. The owner has every permission; team owners and team admins are admins
locked: This cannot be changed, so the project always has someone to manage it

permHint.manage_members: Invite people into the project and remove them
permHint.change_roles: Make people members or mentors; only the owner makes someone an admin
permHint.edit_settings: Address, default model, environment, repository and merge rules, project site, importing skills
permHint.export_project: Download the project's conversations, documents and files
permHint.create_channels: Create public or private channels and add people to channels you are in
permHint.manage_channels: Edit, archive and delete channels without being their admin, and join private channels
permHint.ask_agent: Have {agent} answer questions, write documents and do work
permHint.tasks: Hand work to {agent} as tasks, review what they return, and reopen closed tasks
permHint.edit_content: Create, edit and delete documents and files, and save them to the library
permHint.share_documents: Create and take back a document's read-only link, which people outside the project can read
permHint.configure_agents: Add and retire AI teammates, and manage skills, MCP servers and shared memory
